title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Venetian Bronze | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized surface space with a wall mount glass shelf featuring an integrated towel bar and thick tempered glass in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. This bathroom vanity shelf helps keep small items accessible while providing a convenient towel bar below.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with a beveled edge
- Solid brass hardware for strength
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place Collection and other versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Glass shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5 Inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available for transitional bathroom hardware
